name: pressable-to-wpcom-migration
description: Migrate Team 51 sites from Pressable to WordPress.com: a read-only audit that reports blockers, decisions and manual work and generates a per-site runbook; guided execution through the Reprint copy, cutover freeze, DNS, post-cutover tasks and decommission; verification checks at each stage; and a shared Team 51 migrations space that tracks each migration's status.
